We have to warn—|Sergeant O'Niner, to his rookie troopers|audio=WeHaveToWarn-Rookies.flac|}} A '''battle''' took place on the [[Rishi moon|moon]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] planned to attack the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in order to end the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] production of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] based there, but a [[Rishi Station/Legends|Republic listening post]] on the Rishi [[Moon/Legends|moon]] near Kamino prevented their [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] from entering the [[Kamino system/Legends|system]] undetected. Grievous therefore decided to capture the [[Listening post/Legends|post]] before attacking Kamino to avoid alerting the nearby [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] to his invasion. He deployed [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] to the moon in a [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|boarding ship]], and the inexperienced Republic [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] at the base failed to spot the approaching Confederate [[Starship/Legends|ship]] within a [[Meteor shower/Legends|meteor shower]]. The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] then attacked the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], taking them by surprise and [[Jammer/Legends|hot-wiring]] the base's all-clear signal so that they were unable to send word to the Republic fleet of the attack. While the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] overran the base, clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]], and [[Cutup/Legends|Cutup]] fled the base through a ventilation shaft. Outside, however, Cutup was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Rishi eel/Legends|Rishi eel]]. Meanwhile, [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] arrived for a routine inspection of the base. They were ambushed by the droid [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] but managed to escape and soon found the three surviving clone troopers. The clones then tricked the droids into opening the [[Blast door/Legends|main doors]] of the listening post and quickly retook the base. When the commando droids stopped responding, Grievous sent a group of battle droids to investigate. Realizing that they couldn't defeat all of the reinforcements, the clones devised a plan to destroy the listening post with liquid [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] in order to shut off its hot-wired all-clear signal and warn the Republic fleet of the attack. Before they evacuated the base, however, Rex noticed that the remote detonator wasn't responding, so Hevy stayed behind to address the problem while the other clones escaped the base through a ventilation shaft. The invading battle droids entered the station's command center and opened fire on Hevy, injuring him. Hevy then manually detonated the explosive, sacrificing himself to destroy the droids and listening post to cut off the all-clear signal. Alerted to the attack, the Republic fleet arrived and intercepted Grievous's fleet, forcing the Confederate ships to retreat. Following the Republic victory, Echo and Fives were both inducted into the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], and the late Hevy was honored for his bravery and sacrifice. ==Prelude== {{Quote|Even though you're all new here, I shouldn't have to remind you that this quadrant is key to the Outer Rim.|O'Niner, addressing the rookie clone troopers at the Rishi Station|audio=KeyToTheOuterRim-Rookies.flac|}} [[File:Grievous_Rookies.png|thumb|left|220px|Grievous confers with Asajj Ventress.]] In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] began to utilize [[Listening post/Legends|listening posts]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to monitor [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] activity. Due to the high amount of casualties suffered by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], new [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were assigned to these stations without undergoing the customary intensive training most [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] experienced before beginning duty. A number of these rookie clones, nicknamed "[[Shiny/Legends|shinies]]"—a derogatory term referring to the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]' spotless [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] that had not yet seen action in battle—were assigned to [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]], a crucial listening post located near the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] on the [[Rishi moon|moon]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], under the command of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[O'Niner/Legends|O'Niner]].''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]'' Seeking to end the production of the Republic's clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] on Kamino, the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] planned to invade Kamino with the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] and [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ships]]. However, Rishi Station played a key role in the protection of the area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] around Rishi and Kamino, and as long as the station was active, the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] would be warned of any Confederate activity in the area. In order to overcome this obstacle, Grievous decided to capture the station before continuing with his plan to invade Kamino. ==The battle== ===Confederate assault=== {{Quote|The outpost is secure, General. We shut down the alarm and turned on the all-clear signal.''"
"''Excellent! Keep that signal alive. I don't want the Republic to find out we're coming.|The commando droid captain and Grievous|}} [[File:ONinerDeath-Rookies.png|thumb|right|200px|Commando droids kill O'Niner.]] Grievous deployed a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of elite [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] in a [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ship]] to the Rishi [[Moon/Legends|moon]] to capture the base there. While the incoming pod hid within a [[Meteor shower/Legends|meteor shower]], the clone troopers inside the listening post raised the outpost's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] to avoid [[Meteorite/Legends|meteor]] damage. After landing with the meteors, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] emerged from their pods and stealthily made their way to the base, [[Death/Legends|killing]] [[CT-327/Legends|CT-327]], a clone [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]] who was keeping watch outside the station, along the way. When the clones in the base lost contact with CT-327, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] O'Niner sent clone troopers [[Nub/Legends|Nub]] and [[Droidbait/Legends|Droidbait]]{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}} to search for him, but the two clones were quickly killed by the attacking droids. O'Niner left the command center of the base to repel the invading droids and ordered trooper [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]] to sound the alarm and alert the Republic fleet. The rookie clone trooper found that the signal was being [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]], however, and O'Niner was soon killed by the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. After witnessing O'Niner's death, troopers Hevy, [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], and [[Cutup/Legends|Cutup]] fled from the base through a ventilation shaft inside the command center. Meanwhile, the [[Sparky/Legends|leader]] of the commando droids contacted Grievous via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] and informed him of their success. The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general ordered the droids to leave the station's all-clear signal on, which, if turned off, would alert the nearby Republic fleet to the Separatist presence in the [[Kamino system/Legends|system]]. This kept the Republic oblivious to the attack and unaware of the incoming Confederate fleet's continued journey toward Kamino. Through a hologram transmission, Ventress reported to Grievous that she had infiltrated Kamino and that everything was ready for the invasion. Meanwhile, the rookie clone troopers emerged from the other side of the ventilation shaft and became situated underneath the listening post's landing pad. However, a [[Rishi eel/Legends|Rishi eel]] appeared and grabbed Cutup before departing the area, further depleting the clones' numbers. ===Retaking the station=== {{Quote|All right, listen up. There's only one target of interest in this sector: ''Kamino''. It's the closest thing we clones have to a home. Today we fight for more than the Republic. Today we fight for all our brothers back home. Understood?''"
"''Sir, yes, sir!|Rex, to Echo, Fives, and Hevy|audio=RexPepTalk-Rookies.flac|}} Rishi Station, however, was due for a routine inspection, with [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] being sent to inspect the base. After Cody contacted the base, a commando droid, disguised in clone trooper [[Armor/Legends|armor]], answered the transmission. The commando droid told the clone [[Officer/Legends|officers]] that the base didn't need an inspection, but the clones were unconvinced, and continued to fly toward the listening post. They landed their [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]], the [[Obex/Legends|''Obex'']], near the base's entrance, and were greeted by a commando droid disguised in clone armor. After the rookie clone troopers launched a [[Droid attack flare/Legends|droid attack flare]], Rex noticed the flare in the distance and promptly shot the droid in the head. [[File:RexCodyCrossfire-Rookies.png|thumb|left|275px|Rex and Cody are attacked by the commando droids.]] As Rex took off the clone's helmet, revealing that the clone was a droid, commando droids stationed behind the crates surrounding the clone officers emerged from their hiding spots and began to shoot at them. During the crossfire, the droids tossed [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] at the clones' [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], destroying the [[Starship/Legends|craft]]. However, the clones escaped the area by jumping off the landing pad. Cody and Rex found the surviving rookie clone troopers—Echo, Fives, and Hevy—and ordered them to take off their helmets, believing that they were droids in disguise. After the clones complied with the order, Rex began to address them with the derogatory "shinie" slang. When a Rishi [[Eel/Legends|eel]] again appeared, Rex quickly dispatched the creature with a single [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot to the [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. As the rookie troops seemed impressed with Rex's marksmanship, both clone officers took interest in the group and gave the rookies their [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] carbine blasters. Rex devised a plan to infiltrate the base by pretending to be commando droid [[Unit 26/Legends|Unit 26]]. While Cody, Echo, Fives, and Hevy waited on both sides of the listening post's entrance, Rex walked up to the [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]]' [[TT-8L gatekeeper droid/Legends|surveillance systems]]. Commando droid units [[07/Legends|07]], [[08/Legends|08]], and [[09/Legends|09]] noticed that there was something different with Rex's [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] and ordered him to take off his helmet for identification. Rex took of his helmet but propped up a droid head in front himself to trick the droids into opening the door. When the commando droids opened the blast doors, the clones ambushed the droids and destroyed them, continuing on to ambush the other droids stationed inside the listening post's main control room. After retaking the listening post, the clones found that the commando droids had hardwired the station's all-clear signal. Meanwhile, Grievous noticed the commando droids were not responding to his transmissions. Suspecting that something was wrong, Grievous dispatched a group of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]] to investigate the listening post. ===Destroying the station=== {{Quote|Hevy, get out of there!''"
"''The remote isn't working; I have to detonate it manually.|Rex and Hevy|audio=DetonateItManually-Rookies.flac|}} [[File:RishiStationBoom-TCW-Rookies.png|thumb|right|250px|The destruction of the listening post]] When the Confederate reinforcements arrived on the moon in a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], Rex noticed that the new arrivals outnumbered the clone troopers and ordered the listening post to be destroyed, an order that surprised the rookie troops. After Echo recalled to the clone [[Captain/Legends|captain]] that their duty was to protect and defend the base, Rex dismissed his concerns, stating that if the base was destroyed, it would deactivate the signal and alert the nearby Republic fleet of the impending Separatist invasion. To destroy the base, Echo offered the use of highly explosive liquid [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]], which was used as a [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] source at the station when the Rishi moon entered its freezing cycle. While Rex and Echo went to retrieve the base's [[PLNK-series power droid/Legends|plunk droids]] that stored the liquid Tibanna, Cody, Hevy, and Fives grabbed weaponry from the listening post's supply room. Outside, Cody, Hevy, and Fives began to fire at the approaching droids. The clones tried to hold off the droids before they could enter the base, but the droids' fire overwhelmed the clones and forced them to retreat back into the listening post. When the clones attempted to detonate the Tibanna inside the plunk droids, they found that the remote activator did not function properly. Hevy offered to stay behind and correct the problem before joining the other clones as they fled the listening post through a nearby ventilation shaft. After hearing the invading droids, Hevy left the control room and hid in an adjacent hallway to avoid detection. Meanwhile, outside the base, Rex found that Hevy hadn't yet evacuated the listening post. He contacted Hevy via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], but Hevy refused to evacuate the listening post until he was able to repair the detonator. Unwilling to accept Hevy's decision, the clones ran to aid the rookie trooper. Hevy, who had been hiding from the droids, utilized his [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]] to fire at the battle droids. However, the droids managed to shoot Hevy in the leg, incapacitating him. [[File:Battle_over_Rishi_moon.png|thumb|left|250px|The Republic repels the Confederate invasion fleet.]] Though Rex, Cody, Echo, and Fives attempted to contact Hevy via comlink while they ran toward the listening post, the trooper did not respond. Before they could reenter the facility, however, Hevy sacrificed himself by manually detonating the explosives. The listening post exploded, killing Hevy and destroying all of the droid forces inside. As the all-clear signal was cut off from the listening post, the nearby Republic fleet—under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]—was alerted to the danger. The Republic armada cut off the incoming Confederate [[Starship/Legends|ships]] over the Rishi moon, and Grievous, realizing that his fleet was outgunned, ordered a full-scale retreat before the Republic could cause major damage to his ships. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|Congratulations. You're not shinies anymore.|Rex, to Echo and Fives|audio=NotShiniesAnymore-Rookies.flac|}} Shortly after the battle, a number of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] were sent down from the Republic fleet to search for survivors of the engagement. On the moon's surface, the ships found the four surviving clones and returned them to the fleet, where Echo and Fives received medals for their bravery; Hevy's sacrifice was also honored by the Republic. Rex then appointed the two rookies to the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] for their distinguished service in the battle. Rishi Station was reconfigured and replaced with a near-identical structure within a matter of [[Standard day/Legends|days]].{{FactFile2014|56|RIS 1-4|Rishi}} Following the battle, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] issued a dead-or-alive warrant on Grievous, knowing that it was only a matter of time before he again targeted Kamino.{{FactFile2014|29|GRI 5-8|General Grievous}} Such was the case several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the destruction of Rishi Station,''[[The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Republic]]'' when the Confederacy orchestrated another plan to invade Kamino; both Grievous and Ventress were chosen to [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|led]] the attack. However, due to Republic resistance, their attempt to destroy the cloning facilities and take control of the planet failed.{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}} ==Behind the scenes== The battle of the Rishi moon first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]," the fifth episode of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], which aired on [[Cartoon Network]] on [[October 24]], [[2008]]. ''The Clone Wars'' Director [[Dave Filoni]] used the battle to show that although commando droids were more useful than the basic B1 battle droids, a large force of B1s was still a threat.
